info.title: TraceMind API
info.description:
Observability for LLM applications: telemetry ingestion (SDK, REST and OTLP) and the analytics, Trace Explorer and evaluation APIs behind the dashboard.

**Authentication.** Dashboard routes use the session from `POST /v1/auth/login` (httpOnly cookie, or `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for scripts). Ingestion routes use a project API key (`Authorization: Bearer tm_<env>_…` or `X-TraceMind-Key`). The two are not interchangeable.

**Errors.** Every non-2xx response has the `ApiErrorBody` shape and carries a `requestId` that matches the `X-Request-Id` response header and the server logs.

post.summary: Send trace, span and evaluation events
post.description: Up to 1000 events per request. Every event is an idempotent upsert keyed by its client id. Events are validated individually: valid ones are queued (202) even when others are rejected, and `rejected` lists each invalid event by index. Answers 503 with Retry-After when the ingestion backlog is full.
Accepts `ExportTraceServiceRequest` in OTLP/JSON. GenAI semantic-convention attributes (`gen_ai.*`) become LLM spans with token usage and cost. Protobuf is not supported (415).

Error403.description: Authenticated, but the role is insufficient.

Error404.description: Not found, or not visible to the caller (no existence leak across tenants).

Error429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after the `Retry-After` delay.

Error503.description: Ingestion backlog is full. Retry after the `Retry-After` delay.

ApiErrorBody.description: Shape of every non-2xx response body.

cacheSavingsUsd.description: What cached tokens would have cost at the regular input price, minus what they cost.

series.description: Cost per bucket and model, for stacked charts.

CreatedApiKeyDto.description: Returned exactly once, when the key is created. The plaintext key is never stored.

average.description: Mean score (thumbs: share of thumbs-up). Null when no evaluation has a score.

firstSeenAt.description: Earliest and latest telemetry, so the UI can pick a sensible default range.

spanId.description: External span id when the evaluation targets a single span.
External span id when the evaluation targets a single span.

coverage.description: Share of traces in the range with at least one evaluation, 0..1.

previous.description: Same-length window immediately before `from`, for trend deltas.

errorRate.description: errors / requests, 0..1 (0 when there are no requests).

estimatedCostUsd.description: Decimal strings: exact NUMERIC from PostgreSQL.

throughputPerMinute.description: Requests per minute over the selected range.

unpricedRequests.description: Requests with token usage but no matching price (excluded from the estimate).

RedactionSettings.description: Declared as an interface (not `z.infer`) so API contracts that embed it can be turned into OpenAPI schemas; the assertion below keeps it identical to the Zod schema.

distinctOutputs.description: Distinct completions: 1 means the same prompt always produced the same answer (cacheable).

spanNames.description: Span names using this prompt (e.g. which step of the pipeline sends it).

accessToken.description: Also set as an httpOnly cookie; returned for non-browser clients.

parentId.description: Parent span id, or null for root spans (and spans whose parent never arrived).

uid.description: Server id: stable link target for prompt history and comparisons.

errors.description: Errors recorded on the trace itself rather than on a span.

isComplete.description: False while spans reference a parent that has not arrived yet.

UserDto.description: Response contracts of the TraceMind REST API (v1). Dates are ISO-8601 strings on the wire.
